say:4:1610538001:1.text: Look, the magic circle! My theory was right!
say:4:1610538001:1.source_cn: 魔法阵显影了！太好了，我的理论研究果然是有效的！
say:4:1610538001:1.male: Look, the magic circle! My theory was right!
say:4:1610538001:1.female: Look, the magic circle! My theory was right!

say:5:1610538002:1.text: Thanks to you, it worked on the very first try!
say:5:1610538002:1.source_cn: 多亏了你的帮助，才能一次成功。
say:5:1610538002:1.male: Thanks to you, it worked on the very first try!
say:5:1610538002:1.female: Thanks to you, it worked on the very first try!

say:6:1610538003:1.text: It's getting late. We should head back to the Lyceum to restore the portrait.
say:6:1610538003:1.source_cn: 时间已经不早了，我们现在就回学校去修复那幅画吧。
say:6:1610538003:1.male: It's getting late. We should head back to the Lyceum to restore the portrait.
say:6:1610538003:1.female: It's getting late. We should head back to the Lyceum to restore the portrait.

say:7:1610538004:1.source_cn: 啊，对了！你答应过要给我签名的……

narration:8:1610538005:1.text: Cassadee leaves briefly and comes back with an armful of collectibles.

narration:9:1610538006:1.text: A quiet sigh escaped you. You begin the work of signing every single item, one by one.

say:11:1610538007:1.text: Thank you so much! I'll treasure these forever!
say:11:1610538007:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，我要把这些纪念品好好收藏起来！
say:11:1610538007:1.male: Thank you so much! I'll treasure these forever!
say:11:1610538007:1.female: Thank you so much! I'll treasure these forever!

narration:13:160105510:0.text: A magic circle lights up, and the image on the painting begins to emerge. Looks like the reagent worked.
narration:13:160105510:0.source_cn: 一个神奇的魔法阵亮起，画像上的图案浮现，看来显影剂已成...
